transcript: This first morning of 2021 up here at East Branch, Saakandaka River, lucky campsite number seven. Cold morning, as you might expect, but it is January 1st, 2021, as weird as that sounds. Beautiful morning, very clear. It was a beautiful night, about midnight, it cleared out nicely. I had a nice fire, stayed up until about 12.30, then I bedded down in the tent and got the heater nice and warm in there. That was great. And yeah, it's winter definitely up here. But look at the calendar, three months until April. Yeah, only three, because you have to go through January, February, and March, and then it's April. So, yeah, new year's upon us, new experiences, new challenges, but I'm ready for it. Ready to move forward, enjoy it, get warmed by the heater because it's cold out this morning. It's in the low 20s, maybe even colder up here, I don't know. I'm not sure if I'm on it. So I'm going to sit by the heater. Unfortunately, the line's frozen, so I can't hook up both the stove and the heater at once. But it is what it is. I'm just going to enjoy this beautiful morning for a while, then I'll make some, probably hot cocoa. I don't want to have any more coffee because I'm kind of dehydrated because I drank a lot of coffee last night and alcohol. So, yeah, it's time to stay warm.
metadata_caption: New Years Eve Camping in Adirondacks
